# sphragis

> σφραγίς — post-quantum hybrid sealing (X-Wing KEM + ChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope)

Standalone fleet crate for multi-device content-key sealing. All cryptography
is behind the `preview-pq` feature (unaudited).

## Key files

- `src/lib.rs` — public API, `SEAL_VERSION_V1`, `WRAP_DOMAIN_V1`
- `src/hybrid.rs` — X-Wing KEM implementation
- `src/envelope.rs` — HKDF-SHA256 + ChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope
- `src/seal.rs` — `seal_for` / `unseal` multi-recipient API, `WrappedContentKey`
- `src/error.rs` — `SealError`
- `tests/known_answer_vectors.rs` — X-Wing KAT + FIPS-203 ML-KEM-768 ACVP KAT +
  RFC KATs + round-trip + negatives
- `tests/provenance_lock.rs` — enforces `crypto-provenance.toml` against
  `Cargo.lock` and the vendored vector files
- `tests/vectors/` — vendored, hash-locked upstream vector fixtures (X-Wing
  draft, ML-KEM-768 ACVP keygen/encapDecap)
- `crypto-provenance.toml` — SSOT for every KAT's standard revision, source
  URL, vector hash, and locked dependency version. Read this, not `Cargo.toml`
  or `DECISION.md`, for current dependency-version facts.
- `DECISION.md` — full design rationale
